note: Iowa DNR campground on the north shore of 171-acre Lake Anita, south of Anita. Electric, full-hookup and non-electric loops with three shower buildings and a dump station; most driveways 25-55 ft, all but one back-in. Closed for utility work from November 1, 2026, expected to reopen by April 15, 2027 (ReserveAmerica, updated October 8, 2026). --Claude
